memoryReview.evidence: apps/palimpsest-atlas/index.html, visual-direction.json and app.config.json reviewed from main
memoryReview.lesson: Documentary story selection is replaced by immediate autonomous map, quantitative observations and experiments.

memoryReview.evidence: Existing comparative description in apps/palimpsest-atlas/visual-direction.json; direct screenshots not available.
memoryReview.lesson: Simple rules are visible through their outcomes, but this sandbox needs geographic causality and branch comparison rather than a pattern grid.

references.observation: Collection encompasses atlases, maps and the aesthetic and technical development of cartography.
references.principle: Map sheets should prioritize the geographic field and functional cartographic marks.
references.application: A restrained atlas sheet, legible place names and separate legend surround the live geography.
references.avoid: Do not reproduce a particular historical map or make invented locations look like historical evidence.

references.observation: Cultural, physical and raster themes are separated at several scales.
references.principle: Distinct map layers should encode a specific measurable geographic attribute.
references.application: Switch between political, terrain, density, culture, fertility, trade and technology layers.
references.avoid: Do not copy real-world boundaries into a procedurally generated fictional geography.

references.observation: Procedural elevation shaping and moisture can produce differentiated landscapes.
references.principle: Land and environmental conditions must be correlated spatial fields rather than independent random tiles.
references.application: Use seeded multi-frequency noise and a spatial coastal falloff to derive the initial geography.
references.avoid: Do not imply the simplified drainage rule is a physically accurate hydrological solver.

concepts.medium: Canvas cartography with authored SVG identity and a continuous text ledger.
concepts.composition: One uninterrupted geographic sheet, side journal, shared year controls.
concepts.interaction: Select an area and change its environmental conditions to compare divergent timelines.
concepts.motion: Immediate geographic panning and discrete annual changes, with visible replay progress.
concepts.rationale: A stable spatial frame makes cause and effect visible without hiding the world.

concepts.medium: A long illustrated HTML chronicle with small embedded map excerpts.
concepts.composition: A vertical scroll of events where each map is an inline explanatory figure.
concepts.interaction: Scroll to different years and open event-specific summaries as reading passages.
concepts.motion: Chapter transitions reveal map excerpts after the associated text.
concepts.rationale: Excellent for retrospective reading, poor for live experimentation and a continuous world.

concepts.medium: WebGL sphere with orbit camera, elevated terrain and rotating labels.
concepts.composition: The spherical world dominates and all instruments appear as floating overlays.
concepts.interaction: Orbit continents and select regions through raycast on the curved surface.
concepts.motion: Inertial globe rotation and camera easing between distant areas.
concepts.rationale: Makes the world attractive but impairs equal-scale branch comparison and adds GPU cost.

selection.reason: A map sheet with common scale and comparable metrics directly supports controlled experiments.

rejected.reason: Reading order would interrupt simultaneous observation of geography and the current simulation.
Projection differences and hidden hemispheres obstruct fair comparison between branches.

tools.reason: Authored Canvas rendering and SVG icon require no third-party art services or online assets.

assets.role: A globe cut by borders and crowned by a settlement marks the app in the catalog.
assets.acceptance: Recognizable at launcher size with a distinct silhouette and coherent colors.
assets.integration: Used by the manifest and HTML and included in the worker precache.
assets.provenance: Original SVG geometry authored for this app, with no imported imagery.

assets.role: Procedural map reveals geography and each simulated social property.
assets.acceptance: Land water and selected territory must remain visually distinguishable on small displays.
assets.integration: Canvas maps read the same state as the ledger and share a camera when compared.
assets.provenance: Seeded original geography and renderer, with no externally supplied raster assets.

risks: Small map labels can collide; renderer skips intersecting labels.
Mobile transport controls must not block access to the journal.
comparisons: Compare the lab view to Palimpsest's library-driven documentary layout.
Compare the map to Kaskad's pattern-centric working surface.
